definitions.explanation: The esteem, respect, or high regard in which a person or institution is held. Also refers to the quality of being honorable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名誉|めいよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
{名誉|めいよ}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was able to receive a prestigious award.

examples.japanese: ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{名誉|めいよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傷|きず}つけられた→傷つける：01935_kizutsukeru⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{訴訟|そしょう}→訴訟：07642_soshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
examples.english: He filed a lawsuit claiming his reputation was damaged by false reporting.

notes:
WRITING:
{名|めい} (name) + {誉|よ} (praise/honor). Literally "name-praise."

USAGE:
{名誉|めいよ} is used both as a noun (honor/reputation) and as a modifier meaning "honorary": {名誉|めいよ}{教授|きょうじゅ} (professor emeritus), {名誉|めいよ}⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧ (honorary citizen).

In legal contexts, {名誉|めいよ}⟦{毀損|きそん}→毀損：13241_kison⟧ (defamation) is a specific legal term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名誉|めいよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to protect one's honor
- {名誉|めいよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傷|きず}つける→傷つける：01935_kizutsukeru⟧: to damage someone's reputation
- {名誉|めいよ}⟦{毀損|きそん}→毀損：13241_kison⟧: defamation
- {名誉|めいよ}{教授|きょうじゅ}: professor emeritus
- {名誉|めいよ}⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧: restoration of honor
